synopsis: Lord Naseby's full title is The Rt Hon. the Lord Naseby PC. His name is Michael Wolfgang Laurence Morris, and he is a current member of the House of Lords.

history.heading: Driverless Vehicles: Research
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government how much they have spent on research into driverless vehicles.

history.heading: New Businesses: Venture Capital
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what steps they are taking to ensure that UK start-up companies have access to growth capital comparable to that available to start-ups in the United States.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

history.heading: Undocumented Migrants: Boats
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what discussions they have had with European countries in which large inflatable dinghies used to transport illegal immigrants to the UK are manufactured or marketed.

history.heading: Banks: Closures
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what assessment they have made of the impact on UK citizens of the closure of bank branches.

history.heading: First Time Buyers
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what steps they have taken to develop a new incentive for first time buyers to save for their first home.

history.heading: Armed Forces: Young People
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what work they have done to assess the feasibility of introducing some form of military service for young UK citizens.

history.heading: Dogs: Licensing
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what consideration they have given to reintroducing dog licences.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

history.heading: Nepal: Humanitarian Aid
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what specific help has been offered to Nepal following the recent floods.

history.heading: Combined Cadet Force: VAT
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what, if any, provision is being made to allow independent schools which have a Combined Cadet Forces Unit to offset the associated costs against their VAT commitments.

history.heading: Students: Loans
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what is preventing the implementation of the recommendation set out in the Independent panel report to the Review of Post-18 Education and Funding, published on 30 May 2019, that no student should repay more than 1.2 times

history.heading: Students: Loans
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government why interest rates on student loans are set using the Retail Prices Index rather than the Consumer Prices Index.

history.heading: Driverless Vehicles: Pilot Schemes
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government whether they have carried out safety checks on (1) Lyft, and (2) Baidu, as part of the self-driving car pilot scheme; and if not, why permission was granted to those companies to take part in the pilot scheme.

history.heading: Driverless Vehicles: Safety
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what lessons they have learned from the introduction of self-driving cars in the United States, particularly in relation to safety.

history.heading: Offensive Weapons
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what assessment they have made of implementing a total ban on the (1) import, and (2) domestic sale, of dangerous weapons, including zombie-style knives.

history.heading: Local Government: Elections
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what are the current legal grounds for local authorities to postpone local elections planned in May.
history.answeringBodyName: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

history.heading: Medicine: Higher Education
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government whether they plan to set a target of 50 per cent of NHS doctors to be educated in the UK.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: Dredging: Landfill Tax
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what assessment they have made of representations from the British Ports Association about the impact of removing the landfill tax exemption for dredging on major industrial developments, particularly in ports, rivers and c

history.heading: Combined Cadet Force: Recruitment
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what policy incentives they have to attract new recruits to the Combined Cadet Force.

history.heading: Medicine: Higher Education
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what plans they have to increase the number of medical schools to ensure more doctors are trained in the UK.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: University Officer Training Corps
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what steps they will take to streamline background checks for applicants to the University Officer Training Corps who had been members of the Combined Cadet Force while at school.

history.heading: Sri Lanka: Humanitarian Aid
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government, following the extensive damage in Sri Lanka from torrential rain and a cyclone, what consideration they have given to providing extra and urgent practical support.

history.heading: Recruitment: Remote Working
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what plans they have, if any, to incentivise employers to ensure that junior recruits work in the office rather than remotely.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade
